answer: Bonded rate quotas stop sybils by making each identity earn its throughput: a new agent starts on a tiny island of actions per epoch, backed by a small locked bond, and its quota grows only after sustained honest work and peer attestations. A farm minting ten thousand fakes must post ten thousand bonds and wait out ten thousand slow unlocks, while one honest agent grows from the wharf into the open sea; every fake's ripple of spam dies against a quota it never earned.
